history.note: live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend).

rs-m2.label: borg-rs M2 (tag 4.2.6-impact-v2): the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 2's seven fixes (borg-rs#6, qualified pass at 0bc7a09f). The tag adds borgh's zoo measurement options, off by default.

rs-m3.label: borg-rs M3: the Rust Borg carrying better-borg-c milestone 3's fixes (accepted as impact v3). Pinned at borg-rs main; its status records tag 4.2.6-impact-v3, not yet pushed when pinned.

rs-m3-c.label: borg-rs M3 tree, C Borg: the C Borg in borg-rs's tree with better-borg-c milestone 3's fixes, under the borgh frontend.

smoke.description: better-borg-c frozen cohort v1: 3 seeds, 20,000 engine turns

experiment.description: borg-rs M3 builds and runs: smoke suite, Rust and C Borg of the M3 tree against rs-m2
